---
description: "Language conventions for Norwegian documentation in team-esyfo"
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Norwegian documentation

Write Norwegian prose with the conclusion or required action first. Prefer
active verbs, concrete actors and short sentences. Preserve established domain
terms, code identifiers and links; do not translate a technical contract while
editing its explanation. User-facing text should avoid internal abbreviations.

Use the existing artifact's language. Write English only where the repository
already uses it for code or technical guidance. Keep explanations factual and
omit decorative adjectives, stock conclusions and repeated summaries.
Read `docs/ordbok.md` for domain terms and `docs/omrader/` for their context.
